Furfural, pyrolyzed in the High Temperature Reaction Furnace at an 1800K coil. Feeds straight into THP Protected PHS.

Red Hot Adamantium plus Vibranium Dye, The intense heat of the Adamantium allows for the Dye to fuse with the incredibly hot ingot, but its still not yet ready.

Phenol plus Formaldehyde with a splash of Sulfuric Acid as catalyst, cooked in the LCR. One of the two ingredients (with MV Sensitizer) that make Basic Photoresist. This plastic is needed to give light something to effect.
Tritanium ingot plus Americium dust, quenched in the CRV with hBN Lubricant and Argon. The CRV's first real job, back at LuV - everything else it does comes later.
All four rare-earth dopants, a Tin Oxo-Acetate Cluster, and Triflic Acid, doped under the Controlled Isotopic Doping Chamber's light-isolated beam column.
Hexafluoroacetone plus Methacrylic Acid, CSTR. One third of the ArF Copolymer Resin blend.
Acetone plus Hydrogen Cyanide plus a trace of Sulfuric Acid. The Ammonium Bisulfate byproduct isn't wasted either it gets cracked back into H2SO4 and Ammonia in the Distillation Tower.
Promethium plasma, condensed with Heavy Water in a Vacuum Freezer. Still carries the Samarium-147 that Pm-147 decays into as contamination though, thats the next step.
The Anthracene + Nitric Acid route into HV Photoresist Sensitizer. Cheaper on EU than the Naphthalene route, faster too!

Naquadria dust plus Enriched Naquadah ingot, quenched in the CRV with hBN Lubricant and Argon. Plasma-quenched, no crystal structure - used as a structural plate swapped straight into UV component recipes.
HCN. Extremely useful, extremely dangerous, exactly as toxic as you'd expect. Feeds Methacrylic Acid and AIBN.

Hypogen Quantum Matrix, Fermium Triflate, and Tengam Triflate, fed through the Quantum Force Transformer with a Raw Intelligence catalyst. First step of a five-stage quantum chain that ends at Quantum Cascade Matrix.
Polyamic Acid Solution, run through a Distillation Tower to strip the NMP solvent back out (which loops right back to feed the next batch). A concentrated, dried-down form of the precursor.

Two routes: the slow way (sinter the compact in the HPSF at a 3000K coil, then quench in a Vacuum Freezer) or the fast way (melt Neptunium, Tantalum, Titanium, and molten Tungsten together in an Alloy Blast Smelter for double the yield) only available when you get to IV and get the IV energy hatch. Although it doesnt need all this its much slower.
A four carbon diol referenced as a down the gamma-butyrolactone branch. Building block for GBL.
Erbium dust plus Triflic Acid plus Oxygen, CSTR. First of four rare-earth dopants collected for the RE-Doped Photoresist Matrix.
Triphenylsulfonium Triflate, molten Alicyclic Resin, IV Photoresist, and PGMEA, blended together. Lots to keep you busy and keep that IV momentum going! You go gurl!
Bred from natural Neodymium-146 via centrifuge and neutron capture. Feeds straight into the Fusion Reactor as molten Nd-147 fuse it with Hydrogen plasma and you get Promethium Plasma.

Acetoxystyrene, Hydrogen Peroxide, and Hydrochloric Acid as catalyst, cooked in the High Temperature Reaction Furnace at a 4500K coil. Comes out molten, with Acetic Acid as a recoverable byproduct. Polyhydroxystyrene or PHS resin is as another, better etching fluid, this alongside the sensitizer coat your new photoresist.

Distilled out of plain Water at a deliberately low yield (it's a rare isotope, after all). Doubles as the Vacuum Freezer coolant that condenses Promethium plasma, and as new way for the fusion's deuterium.

Niobium Pentoxide seperated from the mixed Ta-Nb soup. (Or from pyrochlore directly) The only step left is getting rid of that nasty oxygen.

Stabilized Polyacrylonitrile, carbonized under a slow continuous Nitrogen purge in the Dual-Atmosphere Furnace's inert mode, lots of drip feeding before you get actual fiber out. CO and Hydrogen Cyanide come off as byproducts.

GBL a solvent and monomer precursor feeding the GBLMA monomer branch.

Styrene plus Acetic Anhydride. Feeds straight into PHS Resin, and its own precursor (Acetic Anhydride) comes from the super glue chain which is finished and used in IV. I really suggest you finish the glue line later, its really nice.
Carbon Fiber Tow, heat-treated under Argon at a 7000K coil in the HTRF for a full 60 seconds.
Polyacrylonitrile, oxidized under a slow continuous Oxygen drip in the DAF's oxidizing mode taking a whopping 75 seconds at UV too!
Acrylonitrile polymerized with N-methyl-2-pyyrolidone, Gets spun into actual PAN fiber next. Good luck pronouncing N-methyl-2-pyyrolidone.
Quantum Primed Intermediate, run through the Beamcrafter and that's it, no other inputs. Pure activation, nothing added, nothing removed.
Basic Oxygen Furnace, a specialized machine for producing high quantities of steel.
Pyrochlore dust dissolved in Hydrofluoric Acid, just the raffinate left over once Tantalum's been solvent-extracted out of the mixed fluoride solution. Two ways to end up with the same fluid.
